tools.name: verify_email
tools.description: Check in real time whether an email address exists and can receive mail, by asking the recipient's mail server (no message is sent). Returns code "ok" (valid), "ko" (invalid) or "mb" (uncertain, such as a catch-all domain) with a message.

tools.name: find_email
tools.description: Find the work email address of a person from their name and their company domain. Tries the usual patterns (first.last, flast, first...) one by one and returns the first address the mail server accepts. Each pattern tried counts as one verification. Requires a paid MailTester Ninja key.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_email · Public sink: verify_email, find_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_email · Public sink: verify_email, find_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
